description: PART A - show ARV value in USD ($) alongside Rs. everywhere the LIVE/CURRENT price/NAV is displayed. USD/INR source: the live rate is ALREADY on the snapshot payload as snapshot.index.fxUsdInr (api/market.php handle_snapshot builds it from the latest fx_rates row). $ = navRupees / usdInr. Fallback when fxUsdInr is missing: arv-config.js FEED.fx.fallbackRate (94.95) - do NOT invent a new constant. USD is DISPLAY ONLY - the money path (orders, ledger, cost basis, fills, tax math) stays in integer paise/Rs. and is NOT touched. HISTORICAL / point-in-time rows (tax per-lot nav, deposit nav, transaction-row nav) stay Rs.-only, because converting an old lot at today's FX misstates it - this is the deliberate choice; only live/current figures get the dual Rs./$ display. Depends on FEAT-002 (the $ figure multiplies whatever NAV is shown, so NAV must be correct first).
steps: In js/ui.js add a module-level current-fx holder and a setter, e.g. var currentUsdInr = null; export function setUsdInr(rate){ if (rate && isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) currentUsdInr = Number(rate); }  Also add a getter fallback to CFG.FEED.fx.fallbackRate when currentUsdInr is null.

In js/ui.js add shared helpers: export function fmtUsd(rupees, decimals) - returns '$' + (rupees / usdInr) formatted with sensible USD decimals (default 2; ARV ~= $110 so 2 dp is fine, allow a decimals arg). Return em-dash placeholder when rupees is null/NaN or no rate. And export function fmtDual(rupees, dRs, dUsd) - returns the Rs. string from fmtPrice() followed by a muted secondary '($xx.xx)' e.g. 'Rs.9,998.64 ($111.03)'. Use a wrapping span/markup class so the $ reads as a subtle secondary figure (add a small CSS class like .price-usd in css/core.css: muted colour, smaller/lighter, matching the silver-on-black design; do not let it compete with the Rs. figure).

Thread the live rate into the render funnel: in paintNavTicker(snapshot) and paintServerFeed-adjacent code, call setUsdInr(snapshot.index && snapshot.index.fxUsdInr) at the top so every page that paints the ticker updates the shared rate from the same snapshot. Update paintPrice(target, price, key, decimals) OR add a companion so the top ticker [data-nav-price] shows the dual value; keep the tick-up/tick-down animation on the Rs. figure.

Home hero (js/pages/home.js): [data-hero-price] via ui.paintPrice -> show dual Rs./$. [data-ath]/[data-atl] -> append $ (these are current-scale figures, fine to convert at current fx; label as approximate if the coder prefers). The watchlist ARV row price: ui.fmtPrice(snap.price.nav) -> ui.fmtDual(snap.price.nav). Call ui.setUsdInr(snap.index && snap.index.fxUsdInr) before painting.

Trade (js/pages/trade.js): [data-price] (paintPrice), [data-high]/[data-low] (fmtPrice) -> dual Rs./$. st.snap.index.fxUsdInr is available; call ui.setUsdInr from paint. Quote preview rows that show the CURRENT execNav/effectiveNav may show $ in parentheses; leave the paise money math untouched.

Wallet (js/pages/dashboard.js) and Portfolio (js/pages/portfolio.js): current NAV / [data-price] displays and the current holding value shown at live NAV -> add $ alongside Rs. avgCostNav on portfolio is a HISTORICAL/derived per-unit cost - decide per the historical rule: prefer Rs.-only (it is a cost basis figure), OR clearly label. Coder should keep avgCostNav Rs.-only to stay consistent with the historical-rows rule. Call ui.setUsdInr from st.snap.index.

Admin (js/pages/admin.js): [data-price] current price and the obligation 'ARV price' -> dual Rs./$ (these are current). Use the snapshot's fxUsdInr if the admin page loads it; otherwise fall back to fallbackRate.

Tax (js/pages/tax.js): 'Price used', per-lot nav, deposit nav -> LEAVE Rs.-only (historical/point-in-time). Add a one-line note near the top of the tax view if helpful that figures are in rupees as recorded. Do NOT convert these at today's FX.

transactions.js per-row nav -> LEAVE Rs.-only (historical). legal.js [data-base] = arvBaseInr launch price -> may show '(~$x at launch fx)' using base_fx_usd_inr if trivial, else leave Rs.-only; coder's call, keep it honest (use launch fx 63.50 not today's if converting a launch figure).
Add the .price-usd (and any dual-line) CSS to css/core.css consistent with existing muted/num classes.
Run node --check on every changed js file and confirm the dual formatter handles null nav / null rate gracefully (returns the em-dash placeholder, never 'NaN' or '$Infinity').
acceptance_criteria: js/ui.js exports fmtUsd and fmtDual (and a setUsdInr setter) and reads the live rate from snapshot.index.fxUsdInr, falling back to CFG.FEED.fx.fallbackRate (94.95).

Live/current ARV price shows Rs. and $ together on: top nav ticker, home hero + ATH/ATL + watchlist ARV row, trade [data-price]/[data-high]/[data-low], wallet + portfolio current NAV/value, admin current price + obligation.
Historical/point-in-time figures (tax 'Price used'/per-lot/deposit nav, transactions per-row nav, portfolio avgCostNav) remain Rs.-only.
The $ figure is a muted secondary figure (styled), not competing with the Rs. value; silver-on-black design preserved.
Money path untouched: no change to paise/units math, ledger, cost basis, fills, or tax computation.
env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check passes on all changed js files; dual formatter degrades to em-dash on null/NaN inputs (no 'NaN'/'$Infinity' rendered).
verification: for f in js/ui.js js/pages/home.js js/pages/trade.js js/pages/dashboard.js js/pages/portfolio.js js/pages/admin.js js/pages/tax.js js/pages/transactions.js js/pages/legal.js; do env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check "$f"; done
findings:
Completed and committed as 6eee1a8 on branch fix-arv-usd-display-and-price-spike. ui.js already had setUsdInr/fmtUsd/fmtDual helpers and a paintPriceDual funnel; .price-usd was already in css/core.css; home.js, trade.js, dashboard.js were already wired by the prior attempt (verified via git diff, all correct). This session FINISHED the two remaining render sites: (1) portfolio.js - added ui.setUsdInr(st.snap.index.fxUsdInr) at the top of paintPortfolio() and gave [data-arv-value] the muted $ companion (via setHtml + fmtUsd); avgCostNav [data-avg-cost] left rupee-only per the historical-cost rule; [data-total] left rupee-only (it is cash+ARV, a portfolio total, not a pure live NAV). (2) admin.js - [data-price] now uses fmtDual (switched setText->setHtml) and obligation 'ARV price' uses fmtDual; setUsdInr is called from (o.index && o.index.fxUsdInr) || p.fxUsdInr, so when the admin overview payload lacks a live rate the fmtUsd internal fallback to CFG.FEED.fx.fallbackRate (94.95) applies. Verified rupee-only rule intact: tax.js and transactions.js were never touched (grep confirmed zero fmtUsd/fmtDual/setUsdInr usage) so no revert needed. fmtUsd returns em-dash on null/NaN/missing-rate and fmtDual then returns the rupee figure alone - never 'NaN'/'$Infinity'. All 8 changed/relevant js files pass env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check. Money path (PHP/paise/ledger/cost basis/fills/tax) untouched - USD is display only. TO VALIDATE LIVE: confirm api.admin.overview()/reconcile() payload - if it does not carry fxUsdInr the admin $ uses the 94.95 fallback (acceptable, matches spec); the market snapshot pages use the true live rate. No browser in sandbox, so rendering was reasoned from markup (all dual sites render via innerHTML/setHtml so the .price-usd span is honoured).

[REVIEW FIX 2026-09-04-190000] Issue #5 (dashboard/portfolio USD companion bypassed fmtDual): wallet [data-value] and portfolio [data-arv-value] built the $ companion inline via fmtUsd(paise/100), so the em-dash fallback rendered a literal '(—)' instead of collapsing to Rs.-only. FIX: added ui.fmtDualPaise(paise, dUsd) to js/ui.js - the paise-input twin of fmtDual, Rs. via fmtPaise + muted .price-usd $ companion, obeying the identical no-rate fallback (Rs. stands alone). dashboard.js and portfolio.js now route through ui.fmtDualPaise. node --check clean on ui.js, dashboard.js, portfolio.js.
